tapeLine: Latest sourced close is Monday 19 October, a tech-led rebound: S&P 500 +0.4% to 7,690.73, Nasdaq +1.1% to 26,430.89, Dow -0.1% to 51,966.03, per Yahoo Finance/AP (19 Oct). No Tuesday futures were found.
matters:
Chips rebounded after Friday’s selloff: the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) gained 3.7% Monday and chip stocks were on pace to end a nine-day losing streak, per Anadolu Agency (19 Oct). The Dow lagged as tech rebounded. The VIX fell 7.95% to 18.4, per the same report.

The Nasdaq is still below where it started last week, after falling 4.5% in the prior week, per AP (16 Oct). One outlet (24/7 Wall St) reported a different close (S&P 500 7,709.63); the AP-consistent figures are used here.

Invalidation: whether the S&P 500 reclaims Thursday’s 7,744.81 close (about 0.7% above Monday’s close) or the chip bounce fades.
alsoOnTape: Oil, gold and Treasury yield levels were not found with a dated source and are not carried. VIX closed near 18.4 on Monday, per Anadolu Agency (19 Oct).

regime.tag: Tentative stabilisation: the S&P 500 is about 1.5% below its 7,811.54 record close of 9 October after a one-day bounce from its worst week since June.
regime.sizing: No scheduled macro catalyst was confirmed for Tuesday; the 27-28 October FOMC is the next scheduled evidence.

secondOrder: Friday’s selloff was sector-specific (AI and chips) and Monday’s rebound was the same sector reversing, with the Dow flat: leadership, not the macro backdrop, drove both days. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior regime call, risk-off into the week, did not hold on Monday: the S&P 500 rose 0.4% and the Nasdaq 1.1% as chips rebounded, per Yahoo Finance/AP.
The prior level held: the S&P 500 did not reclaim 7,811.54 and closed Monday at 7,690.73, per Yahoo Finance/AP.
The prior watch item, whether chip weakness would spread beyond the sector, resolved no: chips rebounded (SOXX +3.7%) and the Dow was little changed, per Anadolu Agency.
Whether yields kept falling after the PPI print cannot be graded: no sourced yield levels were found.
The 27-28 October FOMC has not occurred.
